create_project.description: Start a new EDT configuration, extension, or external-objects project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('create_project').

version.description: Platform version string, e.g. '8.3.27' (configuration and externalObjects only; for extension: REJECTED — version is always inherited from the base configuration). Default: Version.LATEST when omitted.

externalObject.description: Optional root to seed for projectKind=externalObjects: 'ExternalDataProcessor.<Name>' or 'ExternalReport.<Name>'; the TYPE token may be English or Russian and is not normalized; Name is a programmatic identifier whose 'ё'/'Ё' is normalized by default according to normalizeYo. Omit for an empty project; REJECTED for other project kinds.

normalizeYo.description: Normalize the Russian letter 'ё'->'е' / 'Ё'->'Е' in the seeded externalObject root NAME (default true). 'ё' in a Name is flagged by the 1C standard mdo-ru-name-unallowed-letter, so normalizing on input stores a compliant name. Set false to keep 'ё' exactly as supplied. The TYPE token is never normalized.

baseProjectName.description: Name of the BASE configuration EDT project (required for extension; REJECTED for configuration and externalObjects). Must be an existing, open V8 configuration project. Use list_projects to find it.

scriptVariant.description: Script variant (Russian or English). configuration: sets the Configuration scriptVariant and default Language code (default Russian). externalObjects: applied post-create via setScriptVariant (non-fatal on failure). extension: REJECTED — scriptVariant is always inherited from the base configuration.

autoSortTopObjects.description: Reserved for future use: auto-sort top-level metadata objects. Accepted but not yet applied in this release (see codestyle.autoSortNote in the response).

create_metadata.description: Add a new metadata object or member to a configuration. Autosort places governed objects; ask the user about manual order. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('create_metadata').

insertPosition.description: Optional 1-based position in the destination metadata collection. 1 is first; omit to append. Refuses values outside 1..size+1 before creation. Not applicable to form/XDTO content, predefined data or standalone external roots.

properties.description: Optional properties to apply at creation, as [{name, value, language?}]. For most kinds this applies 'synonym' (with optional 'language' code) and 'comment'; other property names are rejected (set them via modify_metadata). Templates also accept 'templateType': TextDocument or SpreadsheetDocument (English or Russian). A FORM CONTENT member ('...Form.<F>.<Kind>.<Name>') takes a DIFFERENT vocabulary: 'title' (with optional 'language'), 'parent' (the group to nest a visual item under), 'dataPath' / 'attribute' (the bound attribute of a Field / Table), 'command' (a Button's command) and 'type' (a Group's kind). XDTO PACKAGE MEMBERS ('XDTOPackage.<Package>.ObjectType.<Name>' / '...Property.<Name>' / '...ObjectType.<Type>.Property.<Name>') use a DIFFERENT vocabulary instead: an ObjectType takes the optional boolean flags 'open' / 'abstract' / 'mixed' / 'ordered' / 'sequenced'; a Property REQUIRES 'type' (a built-in XSD type name like 'string', the EXACT name of an ObjectType already in the same package for a same-package reference, or an object {nsUri, name}) plus the optional 'lowerBound' / 'upperBound' (integers, ObjectType-nested properties only), 'nillable' / 'fixed' (booleans, 'fixed'=true needs a 'default') and 'default' (string). A PREDEFINED item ('...Predefined.<Item>') uses yet another vocabulary: 'description' / 'code' on every owner, 'isFolder' / 'parent' on a Catalog / ChartOfCharacteristicTypes (a ChartOfAccounts nests through 'parent' too; a ChartOfCalculationTypes takes neither), plus owner-specific properties - 'valueType' (alias 'type'; same {types:[...]} shape as an mdclass attribute's 'type') on a ChartOfCharacteristicTypes item; 'accountType' / 'offBalance' / 'order' / 'accountingFlags' / 'extDimensionTypes' on a ChartOfAccounts item; 'base' / 'displaced' / 'leading' / 'actionPeriodIsBase' on a ChartOfCalculationTypes item (see the guide for which apply to each owner).

normalizeYo.description: Normalize the Russian letter 'ё'->'е' / 'Ё'->'Е' in the new node's NAME (the trailing FQN segment) and in any synonym / comment / predefined-item description value (default true). 'ё' in a Name is flagged by the 1C standard mdo-ru-name-unallowed-letter, so normalizing on input stores a compliant name. Set false to keep 'ё' exactly as supplied.

commonModuleKind.description: CommonModule top-object only. Selects a standards-compliant flag combination the common-module-type validator accepts (no warning), instead of a bare module: 'Server', 'ServerCall', 'ClientManaged', 'ClientOrdinary', 'ClientServer', 'Global'. Defaults to 'Server'. Ignored for other types. Combine with 'serverCall' / 'privileged' / 'returnValuesReuse'. These are create-time-only (the flag set cannot be re-derived post-hoc).

serverCall.description: CommonModule top-object only. When true, the server module is callable from the client (server call). Valid only with a server kind and incompatible with 'Global'. Ignored for other types.

privileged.description: CommonModule top-object only. When true, the module runs with full (privileged) access. Valid only with the 'Server' kind (not a server call). Ignored for other types.

returnValuesReuse.description: CommonModule top-object only. Reuse of return values: 'DontUse' (default), 'DuringRequest' or 'DuringSession'. 'DuringSession' yields a cached module accepted by the common-module-type validator. Ignored for other types.

modify_metadata.description: Set properties of any metadata node, including managed-form roots, items, attributes, commands, and handlers, and edit a section's command interface. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('modify_metadata').

properties.description: Properties to set, as [{name, value, language?}]. 'name' is the property name (e.g. 'comment', 'synonym', 'indexing'); 'value' is the new value; 'language' is the code for a synonym (default: config default). Required unless the FQN is a Role and a role payload (rights / templates / roleProperties) is given.

rights.description: ROLE only: per-object access rights to set, as [{object, right, value?, rls?, rlsFields?}]. 'object' is a metadata FQN (e.g. 'Catalog.Products' or the Russian 'Справочник.Товары'); 'right' is a bilingual right name (e.g. 'Read'/'Чтение', 'Update'/'Изменение'); 'value' is 'set' (allowed, default) / 'unset' (denied) / 'provided' (default/inherited), or a boolean (true=set, false=unset). 'rls' is an optional Row-Level-Security restriction condition (1C query text); 'rlsFields' is an optional array of field names the RLS applies to (omit / empty = whole-object restriction).

templates.description: ROLE only: RLS restriction templates to change, as [{op?, name, condition?}]. 'op' is 'add' (default) / 'edit' / 'delete'; 'name' is the template name; 'condition' is the RLS restriction text (required for add/edit).

roleProperties.description: ROLE only: the three role properties, as optional booleans {setForNewObjects, setForAttributesByDefault, independentRightsOfChildObjects}. Only supplied flags are changed.

content.description: Members to attach / detach in a structured membership list, dispatched by the FQN's kind (a COMMON ATTRIBUTE's owners, an EXCHANGE PLAN's content objects, a CATALOG's owners, a DOCUMENT's register records, a SUBSYSTEM's content objects), as [{op?, metadata, use?, autoRecord?}]. 'op' is 'add' (default) / 'remove'; 'metadata' is the member object FQN (e.g. 'Catalog.Products' or the Russian 'Справочник.Товары' - only the type token is bilingual). 'use' (CommonAttribute only, add only, default 'Use') is 'Use' / 'DontUse' / 'Auto'; 'autoRecord' (ExchangePlan only, add only) is 'Allow' / 'Deny' (omit to keep the platform default). A Catalog owner, a Document register record and a Subsystem content object are plain references (no flag). Adding is idempotent (a re-added CommonAttribute owner has its 'use' updated, a re-added ExchangePlan object its 'autoRecord'; a re-added plain reference is a no-op). Valid only for a CommonAttribute / ExchangePlan / Catalog / Document / Subsystem FQN (a Subsystem FQN may be nested); cannot be combined with 'properties'.

commands.description: COMMAND INTERFACE FQN only ('Subsystem.<Name>.CommandInterface' or 'Configuration.MainSectionCommandInterface'): section commands to change, as [{command, visible?, roles?, group?, after? | before?}], applied in order and validated as one batch. 'command' is the command FQN, e.g. 'Report.Sales.StandardCommand.Open' or 'CommonCommand.Print'; 'visible' the common visibility; 'roles' [{role: 'Role.<Name>', visible: true | false | 'default' (drops the override)}]; 'group' the panel group to move it to, e.g. 'NavigationPanelImportant', 'ActionsPanelReports' or 'CommandGroup.<Name>'; 'after' / 'before' another command of that group to order it by. get_metadata_details on the same FQN lists the section's commands and groups. Cannot be combined with other payloads.

template.description: TEMPLATE FQN only: TextDocument takes {text, mode?, oldText?, expectedHash?, expectedSource?, overwrite?}. Default searchReplace requires one literal oldText match; append adds exact text; only replace creates a missing file. Replacing an existing file requires expectedHash or expectedSource from get_metadata_details, or overwrite=true. SpreadsheetDocument takes the content to author, instead of 'properties'. An object with any of: 'cells' [{row, col (both 0-based, required), replace?, text? OR parameter? (a print-time parameter name), bold?, fontSize?, hAlign? ('Left'/'Center'/'Right'/'Auto'/'Width'), vAlign? ('Top'/'Center'/'Bottom'), wrap? (true word-wraps the cell text), textOrientation? (rotation in the platform's own unit - TENTHS of a degree, 0..3600, so 90 degrees is 900), autoIndent? (0..100), autoMarkIncomplete?}]; 'merges' [{fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol}] merged cell ranges; 'areas' [{name, fromRow, fromCol, toRow, toCol}] named areas (for ПолучитьОбласть / Вывести output); 'columnWidths' [{col, width?, autoWidthCalculation?, widthWeightFactor? - the share of the free width, only alongside autoWidthCalculation:true}] and 'rowHeights' [{row, height}] column / row sizes. Cells MERGE: omitted properties keep their values; replace:true resets omitted cell content and formatting. Non-empty text/parameter clears the other; an empty string clears the named content. bold:false disables bold; wrap:false unsets placement (inherit). Null counts as omitted; 0/false on numeric/boolean format keys overrides inheritance. Other cells, merges and areas are kept. Valid only for the matching template type; cannot be combined with 'properties' / 'content' / a Role payload.

normalizeYo.description: Normalize the Russian letter 'ё'->'е' / 'Ё'->'Е' in localized-string values (synonym / title) and in the 'comment' property (default true). Matches the 1C standard mdo-ru-name-unallowed-letter. Other free-text strings can be identifier-like (e.g. XDTOPackage.namespace is a URI) and always keep the supplied value. Set false to keep 'ё' exactly as supplied everywhere.

write_module_source.description: Create or edit BSL source in a metadata module. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('write_module_source').

modulePath.description: src/-relative module path, e.g. 'CommonModules/MyModule/Module.bsl'. Alternative to objectName (pass exactly one).

oldSource.description: Fragment to find and replace; required for searchReplace, must match exactly once.

methodName.description: Existing anchor method; required for replaceMethod, insertBefore, and insertAfter.

expectedHash.description: Lost-update guard: the hash from the read that produced your edit. The write is rejected if the module changed since; required for every method-targeted mode.

read_method_source.description: Inspect the source of one BSL procedure or function. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('read_method_source').

get_project_errors.description: Find detailed validation errors and warnings in an EDT project. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('get_project_errors').

objects.description: Loose case-insensitive SUBSTRING match against the reported location; mutually exclusive with objectFqns.

objectFqns.description: EXACT model addresses; mutually exclusive with objects. A MEMBER address (Catalog.Products.Attribute.Weight) widens the scan to its OWNING object - EDT indexes the marker there - so the result can carry problems from elsewhere in that object. Returns objectsNotFound / objectsUnsupported.

build_external_objects.description: Compile external 1C data processors and reports into deployable files. NOT self-contained: the project needs an associated infobase AND a resolvable 1C runtime - without either the call fails with a setup error, not a compile error (see create_infobase / set_infobase_credentials). Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('build_external_objects').

objectName.description: Name of a single external data processor/report to build. Omit to build ALL external objects of the project.

recordBuildTime.description: Optional, default true. When true, the build time is written into each built object's Comment property ("Время сборки: <yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss>") and the .mdo is flushed to disk, so the object records when it was last built. Set false to build without modifying the object (no Comment change, no .mdo diff); the build time is still reported in the response message either way.

adopt_metadata_object.description: Add a base-configuration object or member to an extension for customization. Parameters and examples: get_tool_guide('adopt_metadata_object').

projectName.description: The BASE configuration EDT project that owns the object (NOT the extension) (required)

extensionProjectName.description: Target extension EDT project name; REQUIRED only when more than one extension extends the configuration (otherwise the single extension is used automatically)

includeReferencedPictures.description: Adopt referenced CommonPicture dependencies; forms only, default false

dcs.description: Read, author, and losslessly XML-round-trip 1C DCS schemas, settings variants, form conditional appearance, and form dynamic lists. Call action='get' first; replace, remove and any index-addressed edit require its hash as expectedHash. Query autoFillFields=true fills and exports fields and parameters in this call. Writes wait for disk export. Call get_tool_guide('dcs') for body shapes.

body.description: Mutation body; forbidden for get/options/remove and required by the other mutations.

format.description: Read output; defaults to md. xml is only for a bare schema get.

export_configuration_to_file.description: Export the configuration (.cf) or an extension (.cfe) FROM an application's infobase to a file via the 1C thick client - the infobase's content, not the project's (for project sources use export_configuration_to_xml). An extension project in projectName exports that extension. Refused while EDT reports the infobase out of date with the project: run update_database first, or pass allowOutOfDate=true. outputFile must not exist - it is never overwritten. Returns a jobId when not finished within waitSeconds; poll get_job_status. Full parameters and examples: call get_tool_guide('export_configuration_to_file').
